messages:
Evan Liu: Quick heads-up: hardware partners flagged two timing issues that affect our joint announcement window for H200/Gaudi/MI300. Need a short decision on staggered listing vs. hold.
Marina Ortiz: Summary from partners: - NVIDIA: microcode patch for Gaudi targeted 2026-06-10 (1 week validation). - AMD: MI300 driver patch 5.3.3 targeted 2026-06-22 (3 day partner validation).
Yusuf Ali: Ops note: if we stagger, we should list NA/EU first and gate APAC until vendor validation completes. That minimizes blast radius.
kate_support: Support asks: prepare a short FAQ and a runbook for OOM/derate incidents. Also expose a UI flag "Preview - limited capacity" so customers understand the state.
nvidia_anna: We'll provide an embargoed compatibility matrix and partner validation logs by 2026-06-05. Also can run a small integrator preview on 2026-06-12.
amd_suzanne: AMD confirms 5.3.3 will include a memory-mapping regression fix; we'll push artifacts to partners 2026-06-22 and share validation summary by 06-25.
Evan Liu: Proposed plan: 1) Partner preview (integrators) 06-12, 2) Marketplace soft-list NA/EU with "Preview" flag 06-20, 3) APAC listing after vendor validation (aim 07-05), 4) joint press/GA after full validation window closes (target early July).
Marina Ortiz: Action owners: Marina -> press cadence, Yusuf -> SI dry-run matrix, Kate -> support FAQ + runbook, NVIDIA/AMD -> embargoed matrices.
Yusuf Ali: SI dry-run dates: NA/EU 2026-06-14, APAC dry-run 2026-06-28. I'll push container tags: `redwood/preview:mi300-20260610` and `redwood/preview:gaudi-20260610`. Smoke test command: `docker run --rm --gpus=all redwood/preview:mi300-20260610 ./smoke.sh --concurrency 24`
release-bot: Pipeline note: `marketplace-preview` scheduled for 2026-06-20 16:00 UTC (pending legal sign-off and final artifacts).
Evan Liu: OK. If vendor validation slips, we hold global press and update marketplace copy to be explicit about regional availability and fallback routing (H200 -> H100). Thanks everyone.
